project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite SPA with Capacitor for Android/iOS, social media app called Aurelix
build_system: Vite with bun package manager, Capacitor for native builds, Gradle for Android APK
test_framework: vitest with jsdom, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run build` to confirm Vite build passes. 2. Run `bun run test -- --run` to confirm tests pass. 3. Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` for type checking.
setup_instructions: 1. `bun install` in project root. 2. For Android: set JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/21.0.2, run `bun run cap:build:android`, then `./gradlew clean assembleDebug --no-daemon` in android/
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Android SDK at /projects/sandbox/android-sdk. JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/21.0.2. GitHub REST API only (no GraphQL).
contribution_requirements: Use gh api REST endpoints for PR operations. APK artifacts go to .lovable/ directory.
key_patterns: Lazy-loaded routes in App.tsx, AuthProvider with Supabase session management, ProtectedRoute for auth gating, shadcn/ui components, Cloudinary for media uploads, useInfiniteSupabase hook for paginated data, services directory for business logic
directory_structure: src/pages/ (58 page components), src/components/ (auth, layout, social, ui, wallet, etc.), src/hooks/, src/services/, src/contexts/, src/types/, android/ (Capacitor Android project), supabase/ (config)
